column1: # generated_cli_tools.tsv -- every CLI tool install.sh WRITES into ~/.ostler/bin/,
# and whether a Sparkle upgrade refreshes it.
# READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A ROW.
# THE PROBLEM IT RECORDS. install.sh's upgrade branch (OSTLER_UPGRADE_MODE /
# OSTLER_UPGRADE_ROLLBACK) exits at install.sh:1005/1030/1042. Every
# `cat > "${OSTLER_DIR}/bin/..."` site sits after line 19000. So an upgrade
# swaps the daemon and the app bundle and leaves every generated shell tool at
# whatever version the customer first installed. Measured 2026-09-05 on
# origin/main: 7 generated tools, 0 refreshed on upgrade, 0 bin/ writes inside
# the upgrade branch at all.
# install.sh:280 already states the mechanism, about a different function:
#   "the Sparkle upgrade path (OSTLER_UPGRADE_MODE) calls it and then exits --
#    it can never reach a definition further down the file."
# That hoist fixed it for ONE function and was never generalised.
# WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR. It is not a fix. It is a denominator. The reach of a
# change to any tool below is "fresh installs only", and that fact has to be
# stated somewhere a reviewer will see it rather than rediscovered per PR.
# refreshed_on_upgrade:
#   no   -- an upgrading customer keeps their existing copy, for ever
#   yes  -- the upgrade path rewrites it (nothing does today; the column exists
#           so that fixing this is a row edit and not a schema change)
# tool<TAB>refreshed_on_upgrade<TAB>write_site<TAB>reach_note
